column1: # LUAU-2 (review 2026-11-21): the local a module binds another module to
# never collides with the generator's own locals (the module table _M and the
# runtime _Rt) and is a Luau identifier for any file name schema check admits.
# TestLuauRequireAliasNeverCollides generates every module of each unit,
# requires each one, runs the check, and passes every module through
# dir: the unit's schema files; each declares a type and a table another
#      file's type and table reach, so the type modules, the table modules and
#      the cross-file requires all bind the file names.
# check: a Luau expression over Use (the module of Use.schema) that must hold.
# the defect: files named after the generator's locals, bare (M, Rt) and as
# the locals themselves (_M); a basename that is not an identifier (a-b) is
# refused by schema check since SPEC §4.6, so no file name is left that is not
# the control: the same unit under plain file names
